about_the_game: Embark on a serene journey to breathtaking locations tarnished by pollution. With your high-tech vacuum cleaner, restore nature's beauty by clearing trash. Play solo or team up with friends to relax, explore, and make a meaningful impact in this calming game that turns cleanup into an adventure.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1st gen / Intel Core i5 7th gen
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: MD Radeon RX 580 4GB / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3rd gen / Intel Core i5 10th gen
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700XT 8GB / NVIDIA RTX 2070 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
